channel.title: Newspin: latest timeline updates
channel.description: Newspin turns the biggest ongoing news stories in India, the US and around the world into clear, sourced timelines: what happened, when, and what comes next.

item.title: US ground stop: FAA stops all departures across the US
item.description: 2:24 am IST, 14 Nov · Just before 4 pm US Eastern time on Friday, the FAA orders a ground stop for all US airports after "communication issues impacting multiple Air Route Traffic Control Centers", which guide planes at high altitude between airports. Planes already in the air keep flying to their destinations. Some flights over the ocean and from Alaska and Hawaii are allowed to leave.

item.title: US ground stop: Officials: a telecommunications outage, not an attack
item.description: Early hours IST, 14 Nov · The FAA says the problem is not a cyber attack. Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin calls it "a telecommunication outage" and says all flights are accounted for. Airlines pause new departures and cancellations start to climb.

item.title: US ground stop: Ground stop lifted after about four hours
item.description: 6:45 am IST, 14 Nov · The FAA lifts the stop at 8:15 pm US Eastern time. It says it tested its systems first to make sure they were stable. Delta and United say they are resuming flights, but airlines warn that delays and cancellations will continue into the weekend.

item.title: US ground stop: Duffy blames old equipment: "It got overloaded"
item.description: ≈ 7 am IST, 14 Nov · At a late-night press conference, Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy says old switches and routers that carry air traffic data were overloaded and began giving inconsistent data. Mullin says new security patches added to the older system appear to have overwhelmed the routers, and that the outage is not linked to the Microsoft outage a day earlier. Duffy warns there will be more such outages unless the system is upgraded and calls for funding, saying "This is an emergency."

item.title: US ground stop: Thousands more cancellations as airlines recover
item.description: Saturday, 14 Nov · FlightAware counts more than 2,000 flights within, into or out of the US cancelled for Saturday, as planes and crews are out of place after Friday's stop. Delta is letting passengers change Friday and Saturday flights without extra cost; United is waiving change fees for travel between 12 and 20 November.

item.title: Flying this winter: US flights halted for four hours
item.description: 14 Nov · A nationwide ground stop in the US, from 2:24 am to 6:45 am India time, cancels thousands of flights. Travellers flying to or from the US this weekend should check their connections. See the full timeline of the US ground stop.

item.title: SpiceJet: Board to consider raising money
item.description: 13 Nov · SpiceJet tells the stock exchanges that its board will meet on 18 November to consider raising fresh capital through shares, preference shares, debt or a share sale to institutional investors.

item.title: Delhi air: NCR schools go hybrid; severe air forecast to last
item.description: 13 Nov 2026 · Noida, Greater Noida and Ghaziabad move classes up to grade 5 to hybrid mode, and Ghaziabad halts government and private construction until 20 November. The weather office (IMD) expects air to stay 'very poor' to 'severe' until 16 November. Stage III curbs remain; no move to Stage IV had been announced.

item.title: Nvidia & Huang: Market value falls below $4 trillion
item.description: 13 Nov 2026 · Nvidia shares fall 2% to close at $162.85, ending the week down about 12%, and its market value closes below $4 trillion. It was worth as much as $5.75 trillion on 5 October. HSBC downgrades the stock to Hold and cuts its price target to $170 from $365, a day after Bernstein cut its target to $200 from $400.

item.title: AI this week: ChatGPT agents can now pay for things
item.description: 13 Nov 2026 · OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for US Pro users, letting its agents make purchases with card networks' tokens after the user approves each one.

item.title: AI this week: Anthropic IPO reportedly six times oversubscribed
item.description: 12–13 Nov 2026 · Bloomberg News reports demand for Anthropic's shares at about six times the shares on offer, ahead of pricing expected on 18 November.

item.title: OpenAI: ChatGPT Wallet and security agents
item.description: 12–13 Nov 2026 · OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet, which lets its 'dots' AI agents buy things for users, with American Express, Mastercard and Visa. It is limited at first to ChatGPT Pro users aged 18 or over in the US, who approve each purchase with a check such as Face ID; it will not work on sites that block agents. A day earlier, President Greg Brockman showed Daybreak Red Team, in early access, which uses AI agents to test web apps for security holes, and Daybreak Defense Factory, which prepares fixes for engineers to review.

item.title: Anthropic: IPO reportedly six times oversubscribed
item.description: 12–13 Nov 2026 · Bloomberg News reports, citing people familiar with the matter, that the share sale has drawn about six times as many orders as there are shares, and that bankers will favour existing backers, so some buyers may get less than expected. At the top of the range the sale would raise up to $64.4 billion. Demand figures could still change; Anthropic had not commented.

item.title: Outlook outage: Microsoft names a cause and apologises
item.description: 13 Nov 2026 · In an updated statement, Microsoft says the incident "was introduced by an issue during an earlier network capacity upgrade that surfaced following a recent network change", and that it was a technical issue not related to cyber attacks or AI agents. It says it is "deeply sorry", reports broad recovery, and says it will give a fuller explanation in a full incident report. Downdetector data showed services hit in 74 countries and territories.

item.title: West Asia & oil: Oil ends a second losing week; IEA sees a surplus
item.description: 13 Nov 2026 · Brent settles 2 cents higher at $95.84 a barrel after swinging in a $2 range, its second weekly fall in a row. The International Energy Agency (IEA), which advises rich countries on energy, says the oil market will be in surplus this quarter for the first time since the war began, as high prices have cut demand. Iran said four tankers were hit in the Strait of Hormuz the day before.

item.title: Rupee: Slips to 94.20 on US rate worries
item.description: 13 Nov 2026 · The rupee falls 8 paise to close at 94.20 per dollar (provisional). Dealers point to a stronger dollar after higher-than-expected US inflation data, which raised bets that the US Federal Reserve will raise interest rates in December, and to falling Indian shares.

item.title: SpiceJet: Nine of 12 planes flying; staff say salaries are late
item.description: 12 Nov · Mint reports that only nine of SpiceJet's 12 aircraft are flying, with three grounded because the airline is struggling to pay lessors. Two employees tell Mint that salaries are delayed, some by more than four months; Mint says it could not verify this. SpiceJet has not commented.

item.title: SpiceJet: Dubai flights cancelled over unpaid dues
item.description: 12 Nov (Thursday) · Reports say SpiceJet passengers in Dubai were refused check-in over unpaid dues, reported at ₹36 crore, and four SpiceJet flights from Dubai were cancelled. SpiceJet says it has "adequate bank guarantee cover in place" and is in talks with Dubai authorities.

item.title: AI this week: Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · Google's new fast, cheaper model replaces Gemini 3.8 Flash and is rolling out in Search for all users, in the Gemini app and to developers.

item.title: AI model tracker: Google: Gemini 4 Hydrogen
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · Google's fast everyday model, replacing Gemini 3.8 Flash; in Search, the Gemini app and the API.

item.title: Google Gemini: Gemini 4 Hydrogen, the new everyday model
item.description: 12 Nov 2026 · Google releases Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast, cheaper model built for AI agents that replaces Gemini 3.8 Flash as its everyday model. It is rolling out globally in Google Search for all users, in the Gemini app (free users get it through automatic model selection) and to developers at $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens. Google says it finishes tasks 2.5 times faster than 3.8 Flash; these are Google's own figures.

item.title: SpiceJet: A wave of cancellations
item.description: 5–9 Nov · Passengers report cancellations on routes including Mumbai–Bengaluru and Delhi–Pune. SpiceJet is reported to be cancelling 15 to 20 of about 65 daily flights, with delays of three to five hours.

item.title: AI model tracker: Meta: Muse Ember
item.description: 9 Nov 2026 · A low-cost model for repetitive agent work, paired with Muse Wonder.

item.title: Meta AI: Muse Ember, a low-cost worker model
item.description: 9 Nov 2026 · Meta Superintelligence Lab releases Muse Ember, its lightest and cheapest Muse model, designed to handle repetitive agent tasks such as tool calls, coding subtasks and document parsing alongside the larger Muse Wonder. TechCrunch reports a price of 10 cents per million input tokens. Meta says it is cheaper and smarter than Anthropic's Haiku and OpenAI's Luna; no independent tests were reported.

item.title: Flying this winter: Delhi airport's first low-visibility procedures of the season
item.description: Diwali night, 8 Nov · As smog and shallow fog cut visibility on Diwali night, Delhi airport switches to low-visibility procedures, which space flights further apart. About 44% of departures between midnight on 8 November and 8 pm on 9 November are delayed, by about 20 minutes on average.

item.title: Flying this winter: Mumbai airport announces a six-hour shutdown
item.description: 4 Nov · Mumbai International Airport Ltd says both runways will close from 11 am to 5 pm on Thursday 19 November for annual post-monsoon maintenance. Airlines were given six months' notice to change schedules, and a notice to pilots has been issued. The airport handles nearly 1,000 take-offs and landings on a typical day.

item.title: Airfares & fuel: Supreme Court: "Don't travel by air"
item.description: 2 Nov · The Supreme Court refuses to urgently hear a request in a public-interest case against high fares. "Don't travel by air. Next case," says Justice Vikram Nath. The main case, which asks for limits on surge pricing and festival-season fare caps, continues, with a hearing on 16 November.

item.title: Airfares & fuel: New rules let the government cap fares
item.description: 2 Nov · The civil aviation ministry notifies Rule 192 of the Bharatiya Vayuyan Niyam, 2026. The government can order limits on fares in an "extraordinary situation", for a set period. Airlines must publish fares and show a full breakup of base fare, taxes, fees and cancellation charges, and the DGCA will monitor fares. The rules apply from 1 January 2027. Some experts quoted by the Free Press Journal say the rules do not define an extraordinary situation.

item.title: Airfares & fuel: Fourth monthly rise in a row
item.description: 1 Nov · Jet fuel in Delhi rises to ₹138.50 a litre. According to IATA's fuel price monitor, India's domestic jet fuel costs roughly 28% more than the global average.

item.title: SpiceJet: Filing shows small suppliers waiting to be paid
item.description: 30 Oct · In a half-yearly filing, SpiceJet reports that ₹63 crore of the ₹123 crore it owed to small businesses between April and September was unpaid for more than 45 days. The airline gave "invoice received late" as the reason for nearly every overdue entry.

item.title: Airfares & fuel: Airlines add fuel surcharges
item.description: 5–9 Oct · IndiGo raises its fuel charges first. Akasa Air, Air India and Air India Express follow with surcharges on new bookings from 9 October: ₹375 to ₹1,150 on Akasa's domestic flights and ₹400 to ₹1,200 on Air India's, depending on distance, and up to $215 each way on Air India's North America flights. The airlines call the surcharges temporary.

item.title: Airfares & fuel: The biggest monthly jump: up about ₹16
item.description: 1 Oct · Jet fuel rises 13.22%, or nearly ₹16 a litre, to ₹137.12 in Delhi.

item.title: SpiceJet: Market share falls to 0.6%
item.description: September 2026 · In September, SpiceJet cancels 20.29% of flights and only 16.6% are on time at 10 major airports. Nearly two in five flights are delayed by more than two hours. Its domestic market share falls to 0.6%, below the regional airline Star Air.

item.title: SpiceJet: Minister: regulator reviewing SpiceJet
item.description: 22 Sep · Civil Aviation Minister K. Rammohan Naidu says the DGCA is carrying out an operational and financial review of SpiceJet, with safety and passenger disruption as priorities.

item.title: Airfares & fuel: Up ₹6.28 a litre
item.description: 1 Sep · Jet fuel in Delhi rises by ₹6.28 to ₹121.28 a litre.

item.title: SpiceJet: One in five flights cancelled
item.description: August 2026 · DGCA data shows SpiceJet cancelled 20.92% of its scheduled flights in August, against an industry average of 1.04%.

item.title: Airfares & fuel: Jet fuel up ₹5 a litre
item.description: 1 Aug · Oil companies raise the price of jet fuel for domestic airlines by ₹5 a litre, the first of four monthly increases in a row.

item.title: SpiceJet: Lessors move to take back four grounded jets
item.description: 13 Jul · The DGCA publishes notices to remove four grounded Boeing 737 MAX planes from SpiceJet's records after the companies that lease them asked for them back on 9 July. The planes had been idle for over a year.

item.title: SpiceJet: Credit rating cut
item.description: April 2026 · CareEdge Ratings lowers SpiceJet's long-term bank rating to B+, citing continuing losses, a weak financial position and tight cash flow.

item.title: Airfares & fuel: Jet fuel doubles for foreign airlines; domestic rise capped
item.description: 1 Apr · With the Strait of Hormuz closed, jet fuel for foreign airlines and charter operators in Delhi more than doubles to ₹2,07,341 per kilolitre. Domestic airlines get a smaller, staggered rise of 8.56% to ₹1,04,927 per kilolitre (about ₹104.93 a litre), which the oil ministry says is to protect domestic travel costs.
